FUNCTION ADD_MATRICES ACCEPTS(matrix1, matrix2)
  result <- EMPTY LIST
  FOR i FROM 0 TO LENGTH OF matrix1 - 1
    row <- EMPTY LIST
    FOR j FROM 0 TO LENGTH OF matrix1[0] - 1
      row <- row + [matrix1[i][j] + matrix2[i][j]]
    END FOR
    result <- result + [row]
  END FOR
  RETURN result
END FUNCTION
